appDescription.message: A Chrome extension to make web browsing comfortable for people with color vision deficiency

disclaimer.message:
・Low-contrast areas are highlighted with a yellow border
・Alt+click a highlighted element, or use the Check Panel, to change its color
・Your settings are saved automatically per site. They will be cleared if you clear your browser's site data
・Color perception varies from person to person, so please use your own judgment when applying changes

⚠️ Do not use this tool for medical or safety-critical decisions.

panelOpenWarning.message: Please close the color panel first
